draft: The sun casts an orange glow over Mexico City as towering buildings claw at the polluted sky. Streets are congested with buses belching smoke and vendors sell produce that will soon rot in the sweltering heat. Underneath this vibrant surface, tensions bubble ready to explode. In parks, people share rationed water while children play in puddles. Corporate enclaves rise on the outskirts, offering a sterile life for the privileged few. The city pulses with an energy that is both exciting and dangerous, teetering on the edge of something glorious or terrible. Despite its hardships, there's beauty in the resilience and acts of kindness among its people. Mexico City embodies possibility, peril, and indomitable spirit all at once.
